title: Easy-Announce
body:
# About the Plugin
Easy-Announcements is a powerful and lightweight announcement system for Minecraft servers, designed to help staff communicate important information to players in multiple ways. Whether you're notifying players about events, maintenance, server updates, giveaways, or rule changes, Announcements provides a simple and effective solution.

With a single command, staff can send announcements through chat messages, action bars, boss bars, or titles, ensuring that important information is always seen by players. The plugin is easy to use, highly responsive, and perfect for both small community servers and large networks.
 
## Features:
• Broadcast announcements directly in chat.
• Display messages in the action bar.
• Send eye-catching boss bar announcements.
• Show full-screen title announcements.
• Simple and intuitive command system.
• Permission-based access for staff members.
• Supports Minecraft color codes.
• Lightweight and optimized for performance.
• Easy to configure and use.
• Compatible with modern Minecraft servers running Skript.

### Details:
Everything is customazible in the config.yml, you can edit the Sounds, prefixes, and more!

### Commands:

```
 /broadcast chat <message>  Sends a Broadcast chat
 /broadcast bar <message> Sends a Broadcast actionbar
 /broadcast bossbar <message> Sends a Broadcast bossbar
 /broadcast title <message> Sends a Broadcast title
```


Announcements helps server owners and staff keep players informed while providing multiple display methods to maximize visibility and engagement. Whether you're running daily events, scheduled maintenance, or special promotions, this plugin makes server-wide communication quick, professional, and effective.
